name: Archaeological Site of Troy
description: Troy is the ancient city of Homer's Iliad, found near the Dardanelles in Çanakkale, northwestern Türkiye. The hill of Hisarlık hides nine cities built one atop another over some 4,000 years, from a small fortified Bronze Age town to a Roman one. Walking among the stacked walls and ramps, you can see where archaeologists began digging in the 1870s and where legend meets history.
